goal.criterion: Complete the existing autonomous operating loop with independently verified session, continuation and actual runtime ownership
goal.rationale: Finish the existing whole-goal acceptance matrix without manual user relay or weaker verification.

plan.objective: Implement ONLY Scoped research resubmission: actual artifact availability in SPEC.md. Wire trusted bounded content-addressed reads to both owner acceptance and runtime consumption; preserve scoped receipt behavior. Targeted tests/Ruff only, diagnostics in summary, no full suite or deploy.
acceptance_criteria: Exact-policy/intent/family/current-attempt coverage and accepted research binding are mandatory; partial/foreign/stale/unavailable evidence cannot release a hold.
Two families sharing a coarse investigation stay independent; no Portfolio state or old failure verdict is rewritten.
Owner receipt is immutable/idempotent and restart/concurrent consumption preserves one successor and original execution ownership.
Targeted continuation, research-investigation and existing evidence-profile checks plus Ruff pass; no global check/profile/timeout relaxation.

Real artifact bytes must be available and digest-correct at acceptance and consumption; missing/unreadable/tampered/oversized refs or absent verifier never release a hold; both production adapter paths are wired.
